_README: HAND-AUTHORED overlay for the server host GUI's settings catalogue. docs/tools/gen_server_catalogue.py (called by docgen.py build) merges it into docs/generated/server_settings.json. Holds ONLY what the code cannot say: grouping, labels, ranges, page placement, and what to hide. Every cvar name, default, flag, seed and description comes from the sweep. A name listed here that the sweep does not find is reported in the catalogue's 'overlay_unknown' list rather than invented.
_labels_note: labels: the short plain name the MOH Coop Server app shows for each setting (bug-11490). The cvar name stays visible beside it. An overrides label wins. docs/tools/check_servergui_labels.py fails on a visible setting without one.

labels.coop_lootHoldTime: Loot hold time to take gun (s)
labels.coop_mgnestFovSpawn: MG nest spawn field of view
labels.coop_mpGGKillsPerTier: MP gun game kills per tier
labels.coop_mpKothLimit: MP king of the hill limit

sv_fps.label: Server frames per second
sv_fps.description: How many times a second the server simulates the world. The coop servers run 40.

sv_maxRate.label: Max bytes/s per player (0 = no cap)

sv_timeout.label: Drop a player who sends nothing for (s)
sv_timeout.description: 120 = the engine default, the same as hosting from the game. A player who is still loading a map sends nothing, so a very slow PC on a big map can need more. It cannot be switched off: 0 would drop everyone at once, and a crashed player's slot is only freed by this timer.
